cards.example_en: Small habits can bring about a real change.
cards.example_zh: 小习惯能带来真正的变化。

cards.example_en: They will bring the exam forward by a week.
cards.example_zh: 他们将把考试提前一周。

cards.example_en: Please bring up your question in class.
cards.example_zh: 请在课上提出你的问题。

cards.example_en: The hall may burst into cheers.
cards.example_zh: 大厅里可能突然发出欢呼。

cards.example_en: The task will call for patience.
cards.example_zh: 这项任务少不了耐心。

cards.example_en: We may call in an engineer.
cards.example_zh: 我们可能会请来一位工程师。

cards.example_en: Rain might call off the outdoor match.
cards.example_zh: 下雨可能会取消室外比赛。

cards.example_en: We will call on Mr Lin on Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 我们星期天将拜访林老师。

cards.example_en: Please call out your seat number.
cards.example_zh: 请大声说出你的座位号。

cards.example_en: Call me up if the plan changes.
cards.example_zh: 如果计划变了，就打电话给我。

cards.example_en: I care about my little brother.
cards.example_zh: 我很在意弟弟。

cards.example_en: Who will care for the cat this weekend?
cards.example_zh: 这个周末谁来照料这只猫？

cards.example_en: Let us carry on with the story.
cards.example_zh: 我们继续这个故事吧。

cards.example_en: The team will carry out the survey.
cards.example_zh: 这个小组将实施调查。

cards.example_en: You may catch sight of the tower from here.
cards.example_zh: 你从这里可能一眼看见那座塔。

cards.example_en: Run, or you cannot catch up with them.
cards.example_zh: 快跑，不然你赶不上他们。

cards.example_en: Guests check in at the front desk.
cards.example_zh: 客人在前台办理登记。

cards.example_en: Check out the map before you leave.
cards.example_zh: 离开前查看一下地图。

cards.example_en: The teacher may check up on our notes.
cards.example_zh: 老师可能会核查我们的笔记。

cards.example_en: Cheer up. The sun will come out.
cards.example_zh: 振作起来，太阳会出来的。

cards.example_en: Let us clear up this misunderstanding.
cards.example_zh: 我们把这个误会澄清吧。

cards.example_en: That old shop may close down in August.
cards.example_zh: 那家老店可能在八月停业关闭。

cards.example_en: The bank is close to the post office.
cards.example_zh: 银行在邮局附近。

cards.example_en: How did this printing error come about?
cards.example_zh: 这个印刷错误是如何发生的？

cards.example_en: I often come across old photos in this book.
cards.example_zh: 我常常在这本书里偶然看到旧照片。

cards.example_en: The choice may come down to time.
cards.example_zh: 这个选择可能归结为时间。

cards.example_en: New clubs come into being each autumn.
cards.example_zh: 新社团每年秋天形成出现。

cards.example_en: You may come up against a tight deadline.
cards.example_zh: 你可能会碰到很紧的期限。

cards.example_en: Can you come up with a better name?
cards.example_zh: 你能想出一个更好的名字吗？

cards.example_en: People often compare the lake to a mirror.
cards.example_zh: 人们常把这湖比作镜子。

cards.example_en: Compare your draft with the model essay.
cards.example_zh: 把你的草稿与范文相比较。

cards.example_en: Do not complain about the weather all day.
cards.example_zh: 不要整天抱怨天气。

cards.example_en: Please concentrate on the first paragraph.
cards.example_zh: 请把注意力集中在第一段。

cards.example_en: Real skill can consist in staying calm.
cards.example_zh: 真正的本事可以在于保持冷静。

cards.example_en: The group will consist of five students.
cards.example_zh: 这个小组将由五名学生组成。

cards.example_en: Quiet reading can contribute to a better score.
cards.example_zh: 安静阅读有助于取得更好的成绩。

cards.example_en: She can cope with a full timetable.
cards.example_zh: 她能应对排满的课程表。

cards.example_en: You can count on your lab partner.
cards.example_zh: 你可以指望实验搭档。

cards.example_en: We should cut down on plastic bags.
cards.example_zh: 我们应该少用塑料袋。

cards.example_en: The storm cut off the power.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨切断了电源。

cards.example_en: Cut out the repeated sentence.
cards.example_zh: 把重复的那句删去。

cards.example_en: This shop does not deal in phones.
cards.example_zh: 这家店不经营手机。

cards.example_en: I do not know how to deal with this noise.
cards.example_zh: 我不知道怎么处理这噪音。

cards.example_en: Plants depend on water and light.
cards.example_zh: 植物依靠水和光。

cards.example_en: She will devote two hours to chemistry.
cards.example_zh: 她将把两小时用于化学。

cards.example_en: People can die from a bad accident.
cards.example_zh: 人可能死于严重事故。

cards.example_en: In old stories, people die of a high fever.
cards.example_zh: 旧故事里，人会死于高烧。
